sentences.u1: The kettle was already on. I made some tea, and then I opened the mail.
sentences.u2: We drove to the lake on Sunday. The water was cold, so we stayed on the shore.
sentences.u3: My brother fixed the bicycle. It needed a new chain, and now it runs quietly.
sentences.u4: The shop on the corner closed early. I went to the market, and I found what I needed.
sentences.u5: I put the boxes in the hallway. They were heavy, but the stairs were not far.
sentences.u6: The printer stopped again this afternoon. I changed the paper, and then it worked.
sentences.u7: We had lunch in the garden. It was warm outside, so we stayed until three.
sentences.u8: The keys were on the shelf. I locked the door, and I walked to the station.
